page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.16xlarge is a general-purpose server instance belonging to the ecs.g7 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, with a thread-per-core ratio of 1.0. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong multi-core capabilities alongside average single-core performance. The instance achieves a strong multi-core CPU performance score of 62,017.14 in stress-ng and a strong PassMark CPU score of 55,401.5, while single-core metrics remain in the average tier, such as a Geekbench single-core score of 1,603.0. Memory performance is robust, with a strong PassMark memory score of 2,774.99, though raw read-only large block bandwidth is average at 169.75 GB/sec. Multi-threaded operations scale efficiently, as demonstrated by a strong bzip3 multi-threaded decompression rate of 288.7 GB/sec and strong performance in software compilation, ray tracing, and image processing.

With its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.g7.16xlarge is suited for multi-threaded enterprise workloads, database operations, and software compilation. PassMark database operations benchmarked in the strong tier at 25,157.94. However, the lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware limits its suitability for direct high-speed local storage caching or heavy deep learning training workloads. It remains a cost-efficient option for resource-dense general-purpose applications requiring high multi-core throughput and stable network performance without the premium cost of specialized memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware.
